annotations.title: Recommend Vooks titles for a child

description: Pick Vooks titles for one child, given their age, what they are interested in, how many minutes are available and which language to narrate in. Each recommendation comes back with the reason it was chosen, so you can explain the pick to a parent or teacher rather than just listing books.

age.description: The child's age in whole years.

interests.description: What the child likes, in plain words, for example ["dinosaurs", "kindness"].

limit.description: How many to recommend. Defaults to 5.

max_minutes.description: Longest acceptable running time in minutes. Titles longer than this are excluded.

name: recommend_titles

why.description: Why this title fits the request.
